structure: Part 21, Commercial transporter details validation. Read commercial-transporter-details.fit.spec.js in full (describes: adding a commercial transporter that is not on the list, 9 tests; commercial transporter required validations, 7 tests from requiredValidations; commercial transporter format validations, 9 tests from formatValidations; form accessibility, 2 tests) and mined all 16 traces the part names: 7 required-validation traces (570c1 approval number, 3454b name, dc4d8 address line 1, c115a town or city, 5e014 postcode, eb473 email, 534b9 phone) and 9 format-validation traces (0b3fa approval number 51 chars, 2721f name 256, fc03b address line 1 256, c51b9 address line 2 256, c86a2 town 101, 0415e county 101, 4919b postcode 13, 3a710 email 255, c3183 phone 21). The trace CLI's open extracts each zip but then refuses it (TraceVersionError: trace created by a newer Playwright), so each trace was opened through tim and its extracted 1-trace.trace, 1-trace.network and test.trace were read with jq: the fills, the frame snapshot taken at the error-summary link click, the error summary, inline errors, input classes, aria-describedby and preserved values, the /transporters network calls, and the test steps. Every trace walks the same path: sign in, start a notification (origin France, commodity Felis catus, 1 animal), Transporters, Add a transporter, Commercial radio, Save and continue, land on GET /live-animals/notifications/{ref}/transporters/add/commercial, fill all nine fields with the valid transporter (one field blanked or over-long), Save and continue. The POST re-renders the form with status 200 in its error state: page title prefixed 'Error: ', a 'There is a problem' error summary above the caption with one link per error, the field's form group in error with an inline message. The test then clicks the summary link and asserts the field is focused and its value (blank or over-long) and the authorisation number are preserved. The full error-state main of trace c3183 (phone over 20) was dumped to the work folder (phone-error.html) and gives the whole form skeleton: journey strip, caption, heading, guidance banner, nine fields, fixed country, contact heading, button. Every trace shows exactly one error at a time; none drives several at once, any format rule beyond length, or a value exactly at the limit, so those are recorded as gaps.

claims.statement: Choosing Commercial on the add-transporter type question and saving posts to /transporters/add, which redirects (302) to the commercial transporter form at /transporters/add/commercial.
Submitting the commercial transporter form with a validation error does not redirect: the POST to /transporters/add/commercial answers 200 and re-renders the form in its error state.
In its error state the commercial transporter page's title is prefixed with 'Error: '.
claims.ref: all 16 traces, frame snapshot at the error-summary link click (e.g. 570c1 call@4507)
claims.quote: Error: Add commercial transporter - Import notification service - GOV.UK

claims.statement: The error state shows a GOV.UK error summary titled 'There is a problem'.
The error summary sits at the top of the form column, after the journey strip and before the 'Add a new transporter' caption and the heading.
claims.quote: Add a new transporter

claims.statement: Each error summary entry is a link whose href is the id of the field in error (#approvalNumber, #nameOrOrganisationName, #addressLine1, #addressLine2, #townOrCity, #county, #postalOrZipCode, #emailAddress, #telephoneNumber).
claims.ref: all 16 traces, error summary links in the snapshot at the link click
claims.quote: Phone number must be 20 characters or less

claims.statement: Clicking an error summary link moves focus to the field in error.
claims.ref: all 16 traces, test step Expect "toBeFocused" after the summary link click (e.g. 570c1 expect@80); spec lines 291-292, 316-317

claims.statement: The field in error shows an inline error message, the same text as its summary link, preceded by a visually hidden 'Error:'.
claims.quote: Error: Phone number must be 20 characters or less

claims.statement: The inline error message sits between the label (and hint) and the input, and has the id <field>-error.
Only the form group of the field in error takes the govuk-form-group--error modifier, and only that input takes govuk-input--error; every other field renders normally.
claims.ref: all 16 traces, ERROR GROUP and INPUT classes in the error snapshot

claims.ref: 570c1 approvalNumber described=approvalNumber-error; 534b9 and c3183 telephoneNumber described=telephoneNumber-hint telephoneNumber-error

claims.statement: When the form is rejected, every value the user entered is shown back in its field, including the value that failed (blank, or the over-long text).
claims.ref: all 16 traces, INPUT values in the error snapshot; test steps Expect "toHaveValue" (e.g. 570c1 expect@81, expect@82); spec lines 293-296, 318-321

claims.statement: When one field fails, the other fields keep what the user typed: in every required and format trace the transporter authorisation number comes back as UK/BELF/T2/00104115 unless it was the field in error.
claims.ref: all 16 traces, approvalNumber INPUT value=UK/BELF/T2/00104115 except 570c1 and 0b3fa; spec lines 294-296

claims.statement: The transporter authorisation number is required once any other transporter detail is entered: leaving it blank shows 'Enter the transporter authorisation number', linked to #approvalNumber.
The name or organisation name is required once other transporter details are entered: leaving it blank shows 'Enter a name or organisation name', linked to #nameOrOrganisationName.
claims.quote: Enter a name or organisation name

claims.statement: Address line 1 is required once other transporter details are entered: leaving it blank shows 'Enter address line 1', linked to #addressLine1.
Town or city is required once other transporter details are entered: leaving it blank shows 'Enter a town or city', linked to #townOrCity.
Postcode or zip code is required once other transporter details are entered: leaving it blank shows 'Enter a postcode or zip code', linked to #postalOrZipCode.
claims.quote: Enter a postcode or zip code

claims.statement: Email address is required once other transporter details are entered: leaving it blank shows 'Enter an email address', linked to #emailAddress.
Phone number is required once other transporter details are entered: leaving it blank shows 'Enter a phone number', linked to #telephoneNumber.

The required rules apply only to a partly filled record: each required trace fills every other field and blanks one, while the spec's own sibling test says a completely blank commercial transporter record is optional and saves straight to the Overview. So the form validates as all-or-nothing rather than requiring each field outright.
claims.quote: a completely blank commercial transporter record is optional
claims.note: The blank-record trace belongs to another part; this part's traces only show the partly filled case.

claims.statement: Address line 2 and county are never required: no required-validation test exists for them, and their labels say '(optional)'.
The transporter authorisation number must be 50 characters or fewer: 51 characters shows 'Transporter authorisation number must be 50 characters or less', linked to #approvalNumber.

claims.statement: The form page has a journey strip above the content: a blue 'Draft' tag and the notification reference in bold.
claims.note: app-journey-strip is a non-govuk class wrapping standard govuk-tag and govuk-body.

claims.statement: The form's caption is 'Add a new transporter' and its heading is 'Add commercial transporter'.
claims.quote:
Add a new transporter

Add commercial transporter

claims.statement: The error state still shows the transporter-authorisation guidance banner, titled 'Help with transporter authorisation'.

The banner says a transporter must hold a valid DAERA or APHA authorisation if they meet any of three conditions: transporting live vertebrate animals in, to, from or through GB; journeys over 65 km; transporting as part of an economic (commercial) activity.
claims.quote: Your transporter must hold a valid transporter authorisation, issued by DAERA or APHA in the UK if they are:

claims.statement: The banner links to GOV.UK guidance on transporting animals in connection with an economic activity, opening in a new tab.
claims.quote: Find out how to transport animals in connection with an economic activity (opens in a new tab)

claims.statement: The banner says DAERA documents are valid in GB and EU member state documents are not.
claims.quote: Documents issued by DAERA are valid for use in GB.

claims.statement: The form asks for 'Transporter authorisation number' as a two-thirds-width text input named approvalNumber.
The form asks for 'Name or organisation name' as a full-width text input with autocomplete name.
The form asks for 'Address line 1' (autocomplete address-line1) and 'Address line 2 (optional)' (autocomplete address-line2) as full-width text inputs.
The form asks for 'Town or city' (autocomplete address-level2) and 'County (optional)' as two-thirds-width text inputs.
The form asks for 'Postcode or zip code' as a width-10 text input with autocomplete postal-code.
Country is a disabled select with the single option 'Northern Ireland', and a hidden field posts country=Northern Ireland in its place.
claims.quote:
<SELECT class="govuk-select" id="country" name="country" disabled="">
    <OPTION __playwright_selected_="true" value="Northern Ireland" selected="">Northern Ireland</OPTION>

claims.statement: The contact fields sit under a medium heading 'Enter contact details'.
The form asks for 'Email address' as an input of type email with autocomplete email.
The form asks for 'Phone number' as a width-20 input of type tel with autocomplete tel and the hint 'For international numbers include the country code'.
claims.quote: For international numbers include the country code

claims.statement: The form ends with a single 'Save and continue' button in a button group.
The form posts a hidden concurrency token (0 for a new transporter) and a CSRF crumb alongside the fields.
claims.note: The crumb value is a CSRF token: [REDACTED].

claims.statement: The form uses only GOV.UK Frontend components (error summary, notification banner, text inputs, select, button) with govuk width utilities; the one non-govuk class is the app-journey-strip wrapper.
The form sets novalidate, so browser validation does not stop the submit and the server's messages are the ones the user sees, even for the email and tel inputs.
No trace shows more than one error at once, so the order of summary links when several fields fail, and whether every failing field is reported together, is not shown.
claims.ref: all 16 traces each show exactly one summary link

claims.statement: No trace checks an email address's format (for example, a missing @); only blank and over 254 characters are driven, so whether an invalid email is rejected, and with what message, is not shown.
No trace checks a phone number's characters or format; only blank and over 20 characters are driven, so whether letters or symbols are rejected is not shown.
No trace checks a postcode's or authorisation number's format (for example, a Northern Ireland postcode or the UK/... authorisation pattern); only blank and length are driven.
No trace submits a value exactly at a limit (50, 255, 100, 12, 254 or 20 characters), so whether the limit itself is accepted is inferred from the message wording ('or less'), not shown.
claims.ref: format traces each fill limit+1 characters

claims.statement: No trace shows whether leading or trailing spaces are trimmed, or whether a field of only spaces counts as blank for the required rules.
claims.ref: required traces each fill an empty string
